$comment: The desktop performance budget's ceilings on Linux, for pnpm bench:linux, measured in the ngn-el9 image under Xvfb with GSK_RENDERER=cairo at CI runner class (4 vCPU, 16 GB). Provisional, from the Linux spec's section 12 (mountMs, scrollFrameMs, resizeCommitMs, resizeCommitsPerFrame and extraWindowMb are measured on a second launch, of examples/notes/bench/linux-bench.ts): the first stable median plus 20 to 30% replaces each. A cairo number is never compared with another renderer's. A waiver is { metric, reason, pr }.

waivers.reason: The first nightly runs (2026-11-18) measured 133.9 MB PSS on x86_64 and 132.6 MB on arm64 against the provisional 110 MB. Waived until enough nightly runs give the stable median that, plus 20 to 30%, replaces the provisional ceiling.
